name: ink
title: Ink
description: What the ink components share: in lib/ink-core.ts, the same file in React, Vue and Svelte, ink(), which hands an svg to svg-scroll-draw on the scroll (finishing at mid-screen) or once in view, the strokes each component draws, and Hershey's script, a public-domain single-stroke handwriting font, laid out by script(); in lib/ink.ts, the React hooks useInk() and useSize().
